countingRule: Use elapsed UTC time divided by 86400000; a linkage is within the deadline when durationDays <= linkageDeadlineDays.
dateConvention: All timestamps are ISO 8601 instants with explicit Z (UTC). The fixed cutoff is not generated from the current date, and no local-time conversion is applied.
openReceiptRule: For linkedAt=null, calculate age from receivedAt through cutoffAt and keep the receipt in the open-pending denominator, separate from completed linkages.
invalidDataRule: Report invalid records and exclude them from metrics with an explicit issue; never repair or silently discard them.
lossEstimation: Not performed; neither order value nor elapsed time is used to estimate financial loss.
